candidates.description: This feature activates on terms related to human society, social structures, and collective human behavior.
This vector represents abstract nouns denoting systemic actions, processes, or institutional interventions.
This feature vector represents mental concepts, thoughts, and abstract notions.
This vector represents cognitive, intentional, or emotional mental states and internal attitudes.
